ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 75% high-intensity white/light-grey field bounded by 25% low-intensity black perimeter and linear markings.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the lobe tip; significant linear rake marks across the mid-to-lower visible ventral surface.
